NMN can perform a catalytic action to decompose alcohol into harmless acetic acid and reduce the harm of alcohol to the human body. Powerful Repair Function - Repairing DNA damage and regulating or silencing other genes.NMN can re-encode the damaged gene according to the normal gene sequence, helps promote DNA repair, enhance muscle endurance and boost recovery.(NMN and Resveratrol suggest use together for better result.)

This formula is our second Vitamin E product, with vegetarian capsules, a 100% vegan product, each capsule providing 40 mg of mixed Tocotrienols and 135 mg (50 IU) of mixed Tocopherols. RSPO certified to ensure the credibility of palm oil sustainability. All RSPO members that take legal ownership and produce or handle RSPO-certified sustainable oil palm products need to be RSPO certified. Improved absorption - A problem with Vitamin E is, Tocotrienols are not easily absorbed by the body.
